title: Etale extensions commute with composition of finite-height valuations
statement: Let $F\subseteq E$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $A\subset F$ and $B\subset E$ be valuation rings [def-trf-valuation-ring] of finite height such that $B\cap F=A$. Here height is the largest number of strict inclusions in a chain of prime ideals, and finite height means there are finitely many prime ideals. Put $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$ and $l=B/\mathfrak m_B$, where $\mathfrak m_A=A\setminus A^\times$ and similarly for $B$. Let $C\subseteq k$ and $D\subseteq l$ be valuation rings of finite height with $D\cap k=C$. If $A\to B$ and $C\to D$ are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], then the inclusion of the inverse-image rings $\{a\in A:\bar a\in C\}\to\{b\in B:\bar b\in D\}$ is etale. These inverse-image rings are the composed valuation rings in $F$ and $E$, respectively.
